The statement called inflation elevated, partly because of energy supply shocks linked to the Middle East conflict ([Fed statement](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/monetary20260729a1.pdf), [AgWest](https://www.agwestfc.com/education-and-resources/industry-and-economic-insights/economic-updates/updates-from-the-fed/fomc-meeting-results)).
- 2026-07-23: The ECB held its deposit rate at 2.25% after hiking in June. Lagarde said some governors had raised the idea of a hike, and markets are close to fully pricing a September hike ([OrbitRemit](https://blog.orbitremit.com/ecb-rate-decision-july-2026/), [Il Foglio](https://www.ilfoglio.it/en/economy/2026/07/23/news/asp-the-ecb-leaves-interest-rates-unchanged--402995)).
